column2: Deep cinematic trailer impact: one massive low boom with a sub-bass drop and short dark rumble tail, like the opening hit of a true-crime documentary
A heavy official rubber stamp slammed hard onto a paper document lying on a wooden desk, single dry thud with a small paper crunch
A heavy steel prison cell door sliding and slamming shut with a loud metallic clang and a short echo in a concrete corridor
Fast airy whoosh swipe, like a camera whip pan in an animated explainer video, clean and short
Soft cartoon bubble pop, light and satisfying, for a text label appearing on screen
Felt marker drawing quickly on a whiteboard, short squeaky scribble stroke
Quiet pediatric hospital ward ambience: soft distant monitor beeps, faint footsteps far away, air conditioning hum, calm, no voices
Footsteps of one person walking calmly on a hospital linoleum floor in sneakers, about six steps
A small plastic oral syringe placed down on a metal hospital tray, light clink
Short curious cartoon thinking sound, soft rising musical blip, like a question appearing above a head
Record scratch freeze-frame sound effect, short comedic stop, vinyl rewind
Syringe plunger being pushed slowly, soft plastic squeak and faint liquid flow, close-up foley
Hospital patient monitor alarm, high priority rapid beeping, urgent, slightly muffled as heard in the room
Several people running fast down a hospital corridor, hurried footsteps and a swinging door bursting open
Intensive care unit ambience: steady ventilator breathing cycles and regular heart monitor beeps at a calm rhythm
Heart monitor flatline: one continuous steady electronic beep tone, clean, no other sounds
A calendar page being torn off and flipped, paper rip and flutter
Courtroom ambience: low murmur of a small audience before silence, chairs creaking, wooden room, no clear words
A judge's wooden gavel striking the sound block twice, sharp knocks in a quiet courtroom
A fountain pen writing quickly on paper, scratchy handwriting sound
Footsteps of two people walking away and a heavy wooden courtroom door closing slowly with a thud
Clean positive UI checkmark sound, soft bright ding, for a checklist item being ticked
Gentle cinematic reverse swell rising into a soft shimmering whoosh, for a final reveal zoom out
